mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average 5-day return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based demand surge, which increases corporate revenue visibility and reduces recession risk, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 1250.0 and RSAFS > 500000.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed thresholds, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in joint regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which increases the risk of a near-term economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 3.5% combined with a CPI reading above 250.0 signals a tightening monetary policy in response to persistent inflation, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 3.5 and CPIAUCSL > 250.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the joint signal fails to outperform a single-series model in walk-forward IC (Rank IC < 0.02).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below 500,000 million dollars signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and increases the risk of earnings downgrades, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 4.0% and a decline in non-farm payrolls below 148,000 signals a labor market deterioration, which increases recession risk and reduces corporate hiring and investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.0 and PAYEMS < 148000.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05 in joint regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.5% annualized in the most recent quarter signals a weakening economy, which increases the risk of corporate earnings contraction and reduces equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 60% of instances when GDPC1 is below 1.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
